## Activity

During April 2025, Central Eye Clinic completed 211 captures. This activity represents the imaging recorded at the site during the month and provides the basis for the subsequent image-quality review and grading process. The reported total is presented as the monthly activity figure for the clinic.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 7 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.3 per cent. These results are reported separately from the overall activity total to show the proportion of images that could not proceed to grading. The image-quality measure should be considered alongside the capture volume when reviewing the month’s performance.

## Grading

Grading identified 58 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grade was 1 day. This indicates the central tendency of the interval between image capture and completion of grading during April 2025. The referable total and the median grading lag are reported together to provide a concise view of grading outcomes and timeliness at Central Eye Clinic.
